definitions.explanation: Sexually offensive or morally repugnant. Used to describe language, images, behavior, or content of a sexually vulgar nature.

examples.japanese: {卑猥|ひわい}な{言葉|ことば}を{使|つか}わないで。
{卑猥|ひわい}な{画像|がぞう}を{送|おく}るのは{犯罪|はんざい}になりうる。
examples.english: Sending obscene images can be a crime.

examples.japanese: {職場|しょくば}で{卑猥|ひわい}な{冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}うのはセクハラに{当|あ}たる。
examples.english: Telling lewd jokes in the workplace constitutes sexual harassment.

notes: Also written in kana as ひわい. A legal and formal term used in contexts like {卑猥物|ひわいぶつ} (obscene material) and {公然卑猥|こうぜんひわい} (public indecency). Common collocations: {卑猥|ひわい}な{言葉|ことば} (obscene words), {卑猥|ひわい}な{行為|こうい} (indecent act). Stronger and more formal than エッチ (naughty/sexual, colloquial) or いやらしい (dirty, suggestive). Often seen in news reporting and legal contexts.
